title: DNA-measuring Wadjet SMC ATPases restrict smaller circular plasmids by DNA cleavage
authors: Liu HW; Roisné-Hamelin F; Beckert B; Myasnikov A; Li Y; Gruber S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wadjet SMC复合物JetABCD对环状质粒的DNA切割机制，涉及蛋白质-DNA互作与结构解析，但核心是细菌免疫而非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法以冷冻电镜和生化实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故为中档匹配。
abstract:
Summary

Structural maintenance of chromosomes (SMC) complexes fold DNA by loop extrusion to support chromosome segregation, genome maintenance, and gene expression. Wadjet systems (JetABCD/MksBEFG/EptABCD) are derivative SMC complexes with proposed roles in bacterial immunity against selfish DNA elements. Here, we show that JetABCD systems restrict extrachromosomal circular DNA with an upper size limit of about 100 kb, while a linear plasmid evades restriction. Recombinant preparations of a JetABCD complex cleave circular DNA regardless of its helical topology but not linear DNA; cleavage occurs at random positions and depends on ATP as well as the SMC ATPase. We solve a structure of the JetABCD core by cryo-EM revealing an alternative dimer-of-dimers configuration. The two SMC DNA motor units face in opposite orientations—rather than the same as observed with MukBEF—possibly representing a restriction-specific state of JetABCD. We hypothesize that JetABCD is a DNA-shape-specific endonuclease and present a model for the activation of DNA cleavage exclusively when extrusion of an entire plasmid has been completed by a single JetABCD complex. The self-stalling of two opposing DNA motor units may serve as signal to trigger DNA cleavage. Complete extrusion by a single complex cannot be achieved on the much larger chromosome, explaining how self-DNA may evade cleavage.
abstract_zh:
摘要

染色体结构维持（SMC）复合物通过环挤压折叠DNA，以支持染色体分离、基因组维护和基因表达。Wadjet系统（JetABCD/MksBEFG/EptABCD）是衍生的SMC复合物，推测在细菌对抗自私DNA元件的免疫中发挥作用。在此，我们表明JetABCD系统限制大小上限约为100 kb的染色体外环状DNA，而线性质粒则逃避限制。重组制备的JetABCD复合物可切割环状DNA，无论其螺旋拓扑结构如何，但不切割线性DNA；切割发生在随机位置，并依赖于ATP以及SMC ATP酶。我们通过冷冻电镜解析了JetABCD核心的结构，揭示了一种替代性的二聚体-二聚体构型。两个SMC DNA马达单元朝向相反方向——而非如MukBEF中观察到的相同方向——可能代表JetABCD的一种限制特异性状态。我们假设JetABCD是一种DNA形状特异性核酸内切酶，并提出一个模型，即仅当单个JetABCD复合物完成整个质粒的挤压时，DNA切割才被激活。两个相对DNA马达单元的自我停滞可能作为触发DNA切割的信号。单个复合物无法在更大的染色体上完成完全挤压，这解释了自身DNA如何逃避切割。
